messages.subject: Re: Neat output in the mainPanel
parts:
A string you pass to renderText can contain HTML tags. That should do:
return(c("", method, "<br>", "t = ", tstat, "<br>", "df = ", df, "<br>",  "p-value = ", P, "<br>"))

Also consider replacing uiOutput("result") with textOutput("result"), since uiOutput is used for dynamic controls such as buttons and sliders.

On Monday, October 14, 2013 9:22:34 PM UTC-4, Atsushi Mizumoto wrote:
I want an output like this:

Welch t-test
 t =  0.296
 df =  42.986
 p-value =  0.769

But if I write,  
return(c("", method, " ", "t = ", tstat, " ", "df = ", df, " ",  "p-value = ", P, " "))
I get the result in one line.
Welch t-test  t = 0.296 df = 42.986 p-value = 0.769

If I use the list function, I get an error.
return(list(method, paste("t =",tstat), paste("df =", df), paste("p.value =", P)))

If I use the cat function, I get the fine output in my R console!
cat("", method, " ", "t = ", tstat, " ", "df = ", df, " ",  "p-value = ", P, " ")

Please someone tell me how I can show the output in the mainPanel.
Since I've been working on this issue for a couple of days, any information would be appreciated.


My ui.R is:
# ----------
library(shiny)
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(
 headerPanel("Title"),
 sidebarPanel(
    numericInput("nx", " Number of the 1st group:", 21),
    numericInput("mx", " Mean of the 1st group:", 61.33333),
    numericInput("sdx", " SD of the 1st group:", 16.43573),
    numericInput("ny", " Number of the 2nd group:", 24),
    numericInput("my", " Mean of the 2nd group:", 59.79167),
    numericInput("sdy", " SD of the 2nd group:", 18.50729),
    checkboxInput("var.equal", "equal variance", FALSE)
),
  mainPanel(
    tableOutput("values"),
    uiOutput("result"))
)
)
# ----------


My server.R file is:
# ----------
library(shiny)
shinyServer(function(input, output) {
sliderValues <- reactive ({

data.frame(
        n = c(input$nx, input$ny),
        Mean = c(input$mx, input$my),
        SD = c(input$sdx, input$sdy),
        stringsAsFactors=FALSE)
 })

my.t <- function(  nx,
                        mx,
                        sdx,  
                        ny,
                        my,
                        sdy,
                        var.equal = FALSE,
                        )
{
   
    if (input$var.equal==T) {
        method <- " Normal t-test"
        df <- input$nx+input$ny-2
        v <- ((input$nx-1)*input$sdx^2+(input$ny-1)*input$sdy^2)/df
        tstat <- round(abs(input$mx-input$my)/sqrt(v*(1/input$nx+1/input$ny)),3)
    }
    else {
        method <- "Welch t-test"
        tstat <- round(abs(input$mx-input$my)/sqrt(input$sdx^2/input$nx+input$sdy^2/input$ny),3)
        df <- round((input$sdx^2/input$nx+input$sdy^2/input$ny)^2/((input$sdx^2/input$nx)^2/(input$nx-1)+(input$sdy^2/input$ny)^2/(input$ny-1)), 3)
    }
    P <- round(2*pt(tstat, df, lower.tail=FALSE),3)
   
    return(c("", method, " ", "t = ", tstat, " ", "df = ", df, " ",  "p-value = ", P, " "))
}


output$values <- renderTable({
    sliderValues()
})

output$result <- renderText(
{my.t(input$nx, input$mx, input$sdx, input$ny, input$myx, input$sdy, input$var.equal)}
)
})
# ----------
